items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 24 at 10:43PM CST until November 25 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 5
to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM CST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
